# Mukunda Rao Katta

> Senior AI/ML Engineer building agentic workflows, LLM reliability primitives, and production AI systems. Ex-AWS SDE, now at Southwest Airlines. Ships open-source libraries across npm, PyPI, crates.io, MCP Registry, GitHub Marketplace, and HuggingFace.

## Featured projects

- [ragdrift](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/ragdrift): five-dimensional RAG drift detection (crates.io + PyPI)
- [rust-llm-stack](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/rust-llm-stack): 5 composable Rust crates for LLM applications
- [mcp-stack](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/mcp-stack): 14 MCP servers (4 RAG/agent helpers + 10 reliable transforms LLMs reach for instead of guessing)
- [agent-stack (npm)](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/agent-stack): agentfit/agentguard/agentsnap/agentvet/agentcast — composable agent reliability primitives, zero runtime deps
- [Karna](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/karna): multi-channel self-hosted AI assistant (Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage, Web)
- [Chetana](https://github.com/MukundaKatta/chetana): AI consciousness research platform (14 indicators from 6 scientific theories)
- [agent-eval-lab](https://huggingface.co/spaces/mukunda1729/agent-eval-lab): live evaluation harness for tool-using agents
